ambient: Two of the shapes achieve a new relationship, over a long time, and it matters.
The sound changes key without having been a sound.
Something passes underneath which had been above.
description: Shapes the size of countries are moving past each other, very slowly, in a space with no floor and no reason to have one. You understand their business completely and couldn't begin to say what it is. This is the least frightened you have ever been.
name: The Slow Continents

looks: Continental. Patient. Getting on with it.
One of them has been about to touch another for a geological age.
They're the same shape as the sound you can hear.
objects.name: the shapes

looks: Not empty. Occupied by the fact of them being apart.
It closes very slightly, and everything gets more comfortable.
objects.name: the space between them

weather: Somewhere above all this there's a pressure system the size of a country, and it's moving very slowly.
